Hi everyone,
I had a DAS related presentation titled “Data Availability Sampling from the Networking Perspective” in EthereumZurich.
I hope you don’t mind if I share it here. It is:
-  a generic intro (still not everyone outside of this group knows DAS 🙂 ), including the DAS block encoding structure, the data pipeline, etc.
-  some networking considerations, especially around reliability mechanisms in the distribution of samples to validators
- an intro to the simulator that we are building. Still very much WIP, but contributions are already welcome

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=M-xkP4FzYMQ
